notes: Expanded diagnostics: Bazaar health is logged as LIVE/LAST_GOOD_SNAPSHOT with snapshot age, failure class, consecutive failures and recovery events.
Sync logs distinguish desktop trigger reachability from actual laptop transfer, and report rows/snapshots moved plus remaining backlog.
History schema expanded for future analysis with precise timestamps, all Bazaar products, weighted prices, liquidity and 1%/5% market depth.
30-day raw history rolls into hourly history, then into permanent daily history instead of being discarded.
Dual sync throughput is increased; transient Bazaar aborts get limited retries and a safer minimum timeout.
Full database handoff preserves v0.5.9 metadata and rollups.
Graceful shutdown stops timers, collection and sync; a single-instance lock prevents duplicate BazaarFlipper servers.
